data.name: Amazon Commerce Reviews
data.abstract: The dataset is used for authorship identification in online Writeprint which is a new research field of pattern recognition.

additional_info.summary: dataset are  derived  from  the customersâ€™ reviews  in Amazon Commerce Website for authorship identification. Most previous studies conducted  the identification experiments for two to ten authors. But in the online context, reviews to be identified usually have more potential authors, and normally classification algorithms are not adapted to large number of target classes. To examine the robustness of clasification algorithms, we identified 50 of the most active users (represented by a unique ID and username) who frequently posted reviews in these newsgroups. The number of reviews we collected for each author is 30.
additional_info.variable_info: attribution includes authors' lingustic style such as usage of digit, punctuation, words and sentences' length and usage frequency of words and so on
